messages:
Maya: Quick follow-up from RW-512 postmortem (recurring latency spikes). I pulled together the action list — please claim by EOD Wednesday. Summary: cache TTL inconsistency, model fallback not wired, missing regression for long-contexts. Links: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-8712 https://docs.redwood.ai/pm/rw-512
Kevin: I'll take the cache TTL inconsistency. Created INF-8712 and linked to the postmortem. ETA next Thu. @Maya assigning to me. :thumbsup:
Sarah: I'll own the model fallback wiring. Need a short design review. Can we pair with infra? CC @Priya
Priya: Happy to help on infra changes. If this touches the routing layer, we'll need Dedicated consult and a canary plan. Ping me with the design doc.
Jamal: I'll add regression tests and run the eval harness. Will open ticket INF-8713. Do we have repro prompt set or should I extract from request traces?
Maya: Repro prompts in the shared folder: /shared/pm/rw-512/prompts. RACI for follow-ups: Kevin (R), Priya (C), Sarah (A), Jamal (I). If blockers pop, escalate to @OpsSRE.
OpsSRE: Noted. For capacity or routing changes we require a canary + runbook update. I'll file INF-8714 to track runbook edits and rollback procedures.
oncall-bot: incident RW-512 closure note posted: https://incidents.redwood.ai/RW-512
Kevin: Quick Q — cache change may require a DB migration? If so we'll need a rollout window and coord with Dedicated. @Priya any constraints?
Priya: No DB migration required, it's a config fix (ttl reconciliation). We can schedule a low-traffic window. Proposed: Wed 02:00 UTC.
Sarah: Design draft uploaded: https://docs.redwood.ai/drafts/rw-512-fallback.md — requesting review by Tue EOD.
Maya: Perfect. I'll update the postmortem follow-up doc with owners + Jira links. Final ask: add acceptance criteria to each ticket (p95 latency < 100ms, no tail spikes for 48h after rollout) and include a short test plan.
Jamal: Noted — I'll add tests and link them to INF-8713. Also will include the eval harness config and the failing prompt set.
Priya: @Kevin please add the config flag name so infra can validate the rollout scripts and CI checks.
Kevin: Flag is infer.cache_ttl_consistency — added to INF-8712 and the config PR description.
OpsSRE: Canary policy suggestion: start at 5% traffic for 6 hours, watch p50/p95/p99 and error logs, auto-roll back on >3x baseline errors. We'll add logging hooks for immediate rollback.
Maya: Thanks all. I'll consolidate the tickets and schedule a 30m sync for Tuesday to unblock design reviews. Also, I'll start a weekly ownership check for the RW recurring-latency pattern and loop in Product if it repeats during the next two weeks. If owners don't claim by EOD Wednesday I'll auto-assign to engineering leads. :white_check_mark:
Kevin: Sounds good. I'll post the PR and tag reviewers today.
Sarah: Will review PR when it's up.
Jamal: Tests will be WIP, aiming to merge before the scheduled window.
Priya: I'll draft the canary runbook edits in INF-8714 and invite OpsSRE for review.
Maya: Closing the loop — owners: INF-8712 (Kevin), INF-8713 (Jamal), INF-8714 (OpsSRE/Runbook), fallback design (Sarah). Reach out here if anything slips. Thanks! :heart:
